Six high-ranking flag officers from across the NATO command structure and one from a partner nation perform the play Seven during the first performance of the play by members of the armed forces at the Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe in Mons, Belgium. Seven is a work of documentary theater based on the real life stories of seven women's rights activists from seven different countries who overcame obstacles to bring about change in their home countries. The performance was aimed at challenging NATO personnel and the international community to understand, to experience and to promote alternative perspectives on human and women's rights and to stimulate the debate on women's role in society. (NATO photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Joshua Keim, U.S. Navy)
